The Tower is an iconic asset, offering panoramic views in every direction, unrivaled visibility and notable distinction.

Located in the heart of the media capital of the world, The Tower is in close proximity to the three largest major studios in the world.

Renew and recover with exclusive access to a state-of-the-art FIT Health Club with full-service locker rooms in a spa-like atmosphere. Balance your work with private training or group classes like yoga, Pilates and spin.

Energize your morning with delectable offerings from Olive & Thyme downstairs, or choose from dozens of restaurants and retail steps away on Riverside Drive, around the Media District and into Toluca Lake.
Think outside your office walls to get in the game, recharge your creativity and enjoy friendly competition with coworkers.
Be part of the community among the biggest names in entertainment.
